steps.title: Configure App Metadata and IDs
steps.description: Establish the application package identity, dynamic app ID, and project configuration.

steps.title: Define Backend API and Admin Setting Schema
steps.description: Define the API schema configuration indicating local offline storage and empty admin schema.

steps.title: Setup Android Gradle Build Script
steps.description: Configure Gradle build parameters targeting Android SDK 34 without external dependencies.

steps.title: Define Android Manifest and Permissions
steps.description: Set up application nodes, hardware acceleration, screen orientation, and activity definitions.

steps.title: Add Theme and Color Resources
steps.description: Create cyberpunk neon palette (cyan, magenta, dark grid purple, laser yellow) and base theme.

steps.title: Bundle Assets for App Metadata
steps.description: Ensure runtime assets include app-meta.json for identifier references.

steps.title: Implement Synthesized Sound System
steps.description: Create SoundManager using native AudioTrack to synthesize retro jump, coin, and explosion sounds without media files.

steps.title: Implement High Score and Leaderboard Manager
steps.description: Create ScoreManager using SharedPreferences to persist local high score records and rankings.

steps.title: Implement 2D Game Engine and Graphics Pipeline
steps.description: Develop GameView utilizing SurfaceView with cyberpunk parallax skyline, glowing physics avatar, laser hurdles, and coins.

steps.title: Create Main Activity Game Container and HUD Layout
steps.description: Integrate GameView with pause overlay, score counters, sound toggle buttons, and start screen.

steps.title: Implement Leaderboard View and Activity
steps.description: Create a high-score screen rendering user ranks, coins, and top scores with a cyber grid UI.

steps.title: Building CyberRunner
steps.description: Perform build checks and assemble the complete debug APK package.
